lines.zh: 沙沙的脚步声响起，似叶落于地。
lines.en: A rustling sound, like leaves falling.
Moves slowly, like a dream.
Body sways gently with the wind.
Moves through the green leaves like a hermit.
Lightly jumps, like a sprite.

lines.zh: 树叶间穿梭，仿若自然的一部分。
lines.en: Moves through the leaves as if part of nature.

lines.zh: 步伐轻巧，仿佛没有重量。
lines.en: Walks with a light step, as if weightless.
Moves through the grass silently.

lines.zh: 轻柔地触碰地面，如同触碰大地的呼吸。
lines.en: Touches the ground gently, like touching the breath of the earth.

lines.zh: 在树荫下行走，仿佛隐匿于世。
lines.en: Walks under the tree shadows, as if hidden from the world.

lines.zh: 我学着你走路的姿势，落后三步。
lines.en: I copy your gait, three steps behind.

lines.zh: 我的腿一会儿长一会儿短，很别扭。
lines.en: My legs grow and shrink as I go, which looks wrong.

lines.zh: 我贴着洞壁走，皮肤变成石色。
lines.en: I walk along the cave wall, my skin turning stone-grey.

lines.zh: 我跟在你后面，脚印只有一个。
lines.en: I follow you, and there is only one set of prints.

lines.zh: 我下到岩浆边，脚底自己结了壳。
lines.en: I climb down to the lava, and my soles crust over.

lines.zh: 我一个转身，肩背换了个形状。
lines.en: I turn once, and my shoulders change shape.

lines.zh: 静静地站立，注视着前方。
lines.en: Stands still, staring ahead.
Scans its surroundings for food.
Slightly sways, as if in thought.
Sits quietly, as if in contemplation.
Nods its head slightly, as if in reflection.

lines.zh: 轻柔地抚摸树叶，如同抚摸同伴。
lines.en: Tenderly strokes the leaves, as if touching a companion.
L laps at the leaves leisurely.

lines.zh: 静静地呼吸着，享受着宁静。
lines.en: Breathes quietly, enjoying the peace.
Steadily observes its surroundings.

lines.zh: 静静地享受着清晨的阳光。
lines.en: Quietly enjoys the morning sunlight.

lines.zh: 我学你的样子站着，手不知放哪。
lines.en: I stand as you do, unsure where to put my hands.

lines.zh: 我的脸安静下来，五官慢慢挪位。
lines.en: My face goes still, and my features slowly shift.

lines.zh: 我照着水洼，把自己改一遍。
lines.en: I use a puddle as a mirror and edit myself.

lines.zh: 我蹲在暗处，数你眨眼的次数。
lines.en: I crouch in the dark and count your blinks.

lines.zh: 我伸出舌头，试了试空气的味道。
lines.en: I put out my tongue and taste the air.
I do not breathe, and my chest stays still.
Notices the player, eyes fixed.

lines.zh: 凝视玩家，似乎在思考对策。
lines.en: Stares at the player, as if considering a strategy.

lines.zh: 我照着你的样子，慢慢歪头。
lines.en: I copy your posture and slowly tilt my head.
Gleaming eyes, with a spark of something.
Stares at the player, as if waiting.

lines.zh: 凝视玩家，似乎有所忌惮。
lines.en: Stares at the player, as if wary.

lines.zh: 目光从玩家身上移开，似乎感到不安。
lines.en: Eyes move away from the player, seeming uneasy.

lines.zh: 目光回到玩家身上，似有预谋。
lines.en: Eyes return to the player, with a premeditated look.

lines.zh: 注视玩家，似乎在评估危险。
lines.en: Stares at the player, assessing the danger.

lines.zh: 凝视玩家，似乎在寻找机会。
lines.en: Stares at the player, seeking an opportunity.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，眼睛却不像人的。
lines.en: I lift my eyes to you, and they are not quite human.

lines.zh: 我把你的表情记在脸上。
lines.en: I copy your expression onto my face.

lines.zh: 肉体在痛，灵魂却自由了。
lines.en: The flesh hurts, but the soul is free.
This pain is like a knife.
Injured, but not afraid.
Green slime oozes from the wound.
Strength fades.
Poison seeps from the wounds.
Pain drives me mad.
Injured, must find medicine.

lines.zh: 身体受伤，心灵依旧坚强。
lines.en: Body hurt, but the mind remains strong.
Pain, but I won't yield.

lines.zh: 它那伪装的身体让你难以察觉，但别靠近.
lines.en: Its camouflage body makes you hard to spot, but stay away.

lines.zh: 试着接近它，你会成为它的午餐.
lines.en: Try to get close, and you'll be its lunch.

lines.zh: 注意它的伪装，它会模仿你.
lines.en: Watch its camouflage, it mimics you.

lines.zh: 它会改变外表，让你无法识别.
lines.en: It changes appearance, leaving you confused.

lines.zh: 伪装让它成为完美的猎手.
lines.en: Camouflage makes it a perfect hunter.

lines.zh: 它的外表变化无常，难以捉摸.
lines.en: Its appearance is unpredictable.

lines.zh: 小心它的拟态，会骗过你.
lines.en: Be wary of its mimicry, it tricks you.

lines.zh: 试图接近只会让危险增加.
lines.en: Approaching only increases the danger.

lines.zh: 它会模仿任何东西，不要尝试.
lines.en: It mimics anything, don't try it.
Danger lurks in its disguise, don't underestimate.

lines.zh: 你回头时，会看见你自己。
lines.en: When you turn, you will see yourself.

lines.zh: 我换上你的脸，声音也像了。
lines.en: I put on your face, and the voice matches too.
Call my name and I will answer.

lines.zh: 我在洞里模仿你的呼吸节奏。
lines.en: In the cave I mimic the rhythm of your breathing.

lines.zh: 你最好的朋友，刚才就站在这。
lines.en: Your best friend was standing right here just now.

lines.zh: 我不用伪装成怪物，装你就够了。
lines.en: I need not disguise as a monster; being you is enough.

lines.zh: 你撞上了它的身体，却没有察觉.
lines.en: You collide with its body, but don't notice.

lines.zh: 它伪装得太好，撞上你也不会发现.
lines.en: It's so well-camouflaged you won't notice if you collide.

lines.zh: 它突然出现，撞得你措手不及.
lines.en: It suddenly appears, catching you off guard.

lines.zh: 小心它的隐形能力，可能会撞上.
lines.en: Beware its ability to disappear, it might collide with you.

lines.zh: 它在你不知情时，轻轻撞上了你.
lines.en: It gently collides with you, unseen.

lines.zh: 它的身形难以察觉，会出其不意撞上你.
lines.en: Its form is hard to detect, catching you by surprise.

lines.zh: 你撞上它，它却仿佛不在.
lines.en: You collide with it, but it seems not there.

lines.zh: 它的伪装让你难以预测它的行动.
lines.en: Its camouflage makes its movements unpredictable.

lines.zh: 它伪装成普通物体，你一不小心就撞上了.
lines.en: It mimics ordinary objects, catching you off guard.

lines.zh: 它突然出现，轻轻一撞就不见了.
lines.en: It suddenly appears, gently collides and disappears.

lines.zh: 它寻找伴侣，却在伪装中迷失.
lines.en: It searches for a mate, lost in its disguise.

lines.zh: 伪装让寻找伴侣变得更加困难.
lines.en: Camouflage makes finding a mate harder.

lines.zh: 它试图靠近，却被伪装迷惑.
lines.en: It tries to approach, but its disguise confuses it.

lines.zh: 伪装中的寻找，让它难以找到伴侣.
lines.en: Finding a mate in disguise is difficult for it.

lines.zh: 它模仿其他生物，寻找潜在伴侣.
lines.en: It mimics other beings, searching for potential mates.

lines.zh: 伪装让它的求偶过程变得复杂.
lines.en: Camouflage complicates its mating process.

lines.zh: 伪装让寻找伴侣变得不易察觉.
lines.en: Its disguise makes finding a mate hard to see.

lines.zh: 伪装中的求偶，让它难以辨认对方.
lines.en: Mating in disguise confuses it about its partner.

lines.zh: 伪装让它在求偶时显得更加神秘.
lines.en: Its disguise makes it more mysterious when courting.

lines.zh: 伪装中的求偶，让它显得更加难以捉摸.
lines.en: Mating in disguise makes it more elusive.
Consumed on contact!
Survive by blending!
Camouflage is instinctive.
Blend into nature, silently.
Camouflage is my armor.
Hide in shadows.
Don't be fooled by my appearance.
Survive by deception.

lines.zh: 伪装让猎食者望而却步。
lines.en: Camouflage scares predators.
I am part of this.
It moved, prey arrived.
Observe, lock, prey.

lines.zh: 我照着你的样子站起来。
lines.en: I rise wearing your shape.
It's moving, ready.
Opportunity fleeting.
Lock prey, one hit kill.
Prey falls into trap.

lines.zh: 我照着你的样子，慢慢长出脸。
lines.en: I grow a face slowly, copying yours.
It didn't spot me.
Prey at my feet.
Target, precise shot.
I'm memorising your face, slowly.
Target locked, action.
Accurate every move.
Clear target, one hit.
Aim, lock, kill.
Aim, focus.
Target locked, no mistakes.
Precise shot, one hit.
Aim, wait for opportunity.
Sssssss, target acquired!
Touching tendrils, devour all!
Wrap you in my tendrils!

lines.zh: 我的脸正在模仿你的表情。
lines.en: My face is copying your expression.
Tendrils follow you!
Clamp onto your existence!
I walked in wearing your shape.
Tendrils extend, devour all!
Turn you to dust!
Tendrils merciless, devour prey!
Spawn from jar!
Life from the jar!
Independent life origin!
New life in the jar!
Time to hatch!
Little life in the jar!
New power from the jar!
Tiny life in the jar!
Born from the jar!
New life form in the jar!

lines.zh: 火舔过我的脸，表情化了。
lines.en: Fire licks my face, and my expression melts.
Fall from height, bones hurt.
Struggling in water.
Explosion shakes my insides.
Hit by arrow.
Magic burns my skin.

lines.zh: 肚子空了，我借来的脸在垮。
lines.en: My belly is empty, and my borrowed face sags.
Lightning strikes, intense pain.
Void fear无尽。
